title: Bulk UPDATE / DELETE under RLS: USING and WITH CHECK per written row
issue: UPDATE evaluates the policy USING on every candidate old row and WITH CHECK on every new row (plus the SELECT policy when the statement reads the row); DELETE evaluates USING. With function-based policies the per-row cost is added on top of heap + index maintenance.
symptom: naive_rls (plpgsql policy) is slower than the array policy, which is slower than the owner's unprotected statement; the gap is smaller than on reads because heap/index maintenance dominates once the policy is cheap. Every query runs inside the harness's rolled-back transaction (EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the DML).

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents (100 per org). Statements touch id % 2 = 0 rows (50% of the table is scanned/candidate; only the subject's visible subset is written).

subjects.name: selective
subjects.note: member of ~2 orgs: few rows written but all candidate rows hit the policy qual

subjects.name: broad
subjects.note: member of 50% of all orgs: ~25% of the table is written
